summary: Teardown of a large heap object pointed to by *this. Walks and frees two big linked lists (heads at obj+0xE5C0 and obj+0xE5B0), freeing each node via ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck followed by FreeWrapper_7bcf and zeroing the four head/trailer/tail/count fields of each list. Then frees a fixed 104-entry static pointer array, then two flag-linked lists whose head pointers live at obj+0x7C and obj+0x6C (each node carries a flag byte at +8, a next pointer at +4, and an optional payload at +0 freed only when the flag is set). Finally zeroes the four fields of each flag-list, calls EmptyStub_0170, and returns FreeWrapper_7bcf(*this), freeing the object itself.

local_names.v8: array element read and freed during the static-array loop

local_names.v12: node walker for the flag-linked list whose head is obj+0x6C
local_names.v10: current node of the obj+0x7C flag-linked list

operations.description: If *this is nonzero, proceed with the full teardown; the object pointer is read from field this+0x0.
v1 = *this: load the large object pointer (obj) from field this+0x0.
Walk the linked list whose head is obj+0xE5C0 (v1[14704]); per node read the next pointer at node+4 and advance.
Per node of the obj+0xE5C0 list: ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck(node) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(node).
Zero the four fields of the obj+0xE5C0 list: v1[14704..14707] (obj+0xE5C0, +0xE5C4, +0xE5C8, +0xE5CC).
Walk the linked list whose head is obj+0xE5B0 (v1[14700]); per node read the next pointer at node+4 and advance.
Per node of the obj+0xE5B0 list: ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck(node) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(node).
Zero the four fields of the obj+0xE5B0 list: v1[14700..14703] (obj+0xE5B0, +0xE5B4, +0xE5B8, +0xE5BC).
Free a fixed 104-entry static pointer array: walk v1+14734 backward by 140 dwords per iteration, reading and freeing each element.
Per element of the 104-entry static array: FreeWrapper_7bcf(element).
Walk the flag-linked list whose head is obj+0x7C (v1[31]); per node read the flag byte at node+8 and the next pointer at node+4, advancing through the list while the head is nonzero.
Per node of the obj+0x7C flag-list: if the flag byte at node+8 is nonzero, FreeWrapper_7bcf(*node) frees the payload; the node itself is always freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf(node).
Zero the four fields of the obj+0x7C flag-list: v1[31..34] (obj+0x7C, +0x80, +0x84, +0x88).
Walk the flag-linked list whose head is obj+0x6C (v1[27]); per node read the flag byte at node+8 and the next pointer at node+4, advancing through the list while the head is nonzero.
Per node of the obj+0x6C flag-list: if the flag byte at node+8 is nonzero, FreeWrapper_7bcf(*node) frees the payload; the node itself is always freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf(node).
Zero the four fields of the obj+0x6C flag-list: v1[27..30] (obj+0x6C, +0x70, +0x74, +0x78).
Call EmptyStub_0170() with no arguments before freeing the object.
Return FreeWrapper_7bcf(v1), freeing the large object itself.
